package: W142-01 — engine drawn-budget clip and noted handlers (gno slice 2)
question: How does the engine spend its drawn-character budget, clip a tree to it, and report the resulting plain-text and prop rewrites?
answer: Thirty-two verbatim blocks implement it: Rur's written/drawn counters, Tur's tree clip, Nss's cut report, zss's prop clip with own/cut reports, the five noted-warning handlers over DAt/JAe keys, and the source problem-text builders. The copy runs behind a typed seam with no gno caller yet.

semantics.Rur: isHeld spends and answers fit; field returns the possibly cut text; shown cuts at the boundary with a one-shot tail; markOf reports that tail once; any shortfall sets isCut
semantics.Tur: Code/Markdown text, Client key/module/props, Button/Select labels, Svg/Image/Input props, Box keys and Link hrefs spend against the budget; children walk with identity preserved
semantics.Nss: reports written/drawn only when the budget cut
semantics.zss: rewrites a drawn prop only when it differs from and costs more than the input's; own values over OAt revert and report through own; an exhausted budget reports through cut
semantics.handlers: qss/Uss/Bss note borderStyle/plain Code/plain Link through DAt keys and Iye; Wss/Gss note own props/text cut through iIn's [load, component, detail] key; s5t makes each keyed note one-shot

product.caller: none yet; gno wiring and Eur validation remain later slices
